# Youssef Abdelhady

## Identity
Youssef Abdelhady, also known as Youssef Kobaisy and يوسف عبد الهادي / يوسف قبيصي, is a Python and C++ desktop developer and Software Development student in Egypt.

## Website
- https://youssef-kobaisy.work/ — bilingual portfolio and professional profile.

## Expertise
Python, C++, Qt, Tkinter, Arduino, serial communication, data processing, modular object-oriented programming, UI/UX, and software testing.

## Featured project
Invoice Reconciliation is a bilingual desktop application comparing Egyptian Tax Authority records with a company ledger and producing a clear review report.
